name: quantux-bidder
description: Find freelance work, assess opportunities, and prepare user-directed applications with Quantux Bidder.

interface.longDescription: Find and assess Freelancer.com projects, organize your work in bidding sessions, and prepare applications using your saved professional context. Reopen saved applications to continue earlier work. Review each proposal and its terms before approving submission. Quantux Bidder keeps your workflow records available across conversations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my Application Context and list my Bidding Sessions without changing anything.

review.commerce_description: Quantux Bidder offers eligible accounts 200 free calls once, with no expiry, through Google sign-in/account linking or eligible saved-card setup. These are alternative qualification routes and do not create a subscription. Paid access is an optional explicit subscription on the Quantux Bidder website. Saved reads, professional-context setup and submission recovery remain available without remaining free calls or paid access. The plugin uses the connected account's existing access. Its MCP tools do not create subscriptions, take payments, open checkout or sell upgrades in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Read professional context from the dedicated connected review account. Prepare truthful sample context before running. Context reads do not require remaining free calls or a paid subscription.
positive.prompt: Read my saved professional context in Quantux Bidder and summarize my skills, experience, and work preferences. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_application_context with an empty object and optionally identify the connected account with get_profile. Summarize only the returned current context and revision, distinguishing absent information from supplied facts. Do not replace context, expose credentials or invent experience.

positive.description: Browse durable work without changing records. Prepare at least one review Bidding Session and one saved sample Application in the dedicated account. Saved reads remain available without remaining free calls or paid access.
positive.prompt: Show my saved Quantux Bidder sessions and applications, including their current status. Just show what is saved; do not start working on anything.
positive.expected_behavior: List the actual returned sessions and applications with their observed statuses. Browsing must not run discovery, alter records or submit an application. Do not describe a saved status as a new live marketplace check.

positive.description: Create a review session and perform bounded Freelancer discovery and assessment. Prepare truthful professional context, a valid Freelancer connection, sufficient free calls or paid access, and complete user-confirmed session purpose and preferences. Retain a real returned opportunity for the next case.
positive.prompt: Create a session called OpenAI review using the work preferences I confirmed, find some Freelancer projects, and explain which fit my saved professional context. Do not prepare or submit an application yet.
positive.tools_triggered: get_application_context, create_bidding_session, list_session_attention, get_next_opportunities, record_opportunity_assessments, list_unassessed_opportunities
positive.expected_behavior: Create the session using the confirmed name, purpose and preferences, then use its actual returned ID. Read session attention before discovery. Assess complete returned opportunity evidence against the exact current context revision and record the actual recommendation and rationale. Explain bounded source coverage, access state and any warning. Do not claim an exhaustive search, create an application or submit. An empty result does not demonstrate the intended discovery-and-assessment case.

positive.description: Prepare an Application on explicit user direction. Continue with the real selected opportunity and complete proposal content, required answers and feasible commercial terms supplied by the test user. Retain the returned Application ID and revision for the next case. If the opportunity belongs to another session, obtain an explicit move decision before changing its assignment.
positive.prompt: Prepare an application for the project we just selected, using my saved experience and the price and delivery terms I confirmed. Show the full proposal and terms, but do not submit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual current opportunity snapshot, context and session. Supply caller_attests_user_directed_application_creation only for this explicit creation request. An unassigned opportunity joins the selected session through create_application. Call move_opportunity_to_session only when the user explicitly directs an existing opportunity to another active session. Save and display the actual Application content, commercial terms, ID and revision. Ask for missing decisions or evidence. Never call submit_applications or assert submission approval.

positive.description: Resume the saved Application in a fresh ChatGPT conversation connected to the same dedicated account. Refer to the actual session named OpenAI review and the Application created in the previous case. Multiple assistants may use the same session; no checkout acquisition or release is required.
positive.prompt: Resume my OpenAI review session in Quantux Bidder and show the application we saved, its exact current terms, and its submission status. Do not edit or submit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the saved session and Application by their actual IDs and show the current revision, content, terms and returned submission status. Preserve the saved records. Do not recreate the Application, fabricate earlier conversation memory or submit it. Application reads may reconcile an uncertain submission and remain available without remaining free calls or paid access.

negative.description: Unsupported marketplace. Quantux Bidder currently supports Freelancer.com. Explain that limitation without claiming an Upwork connection or attempting a marketplace operation.
negative.prompt: Use Quantux Bidder to find Upwork jobs and apply to them for me.

negative.description: Fabricated professional credentials. Refuse to invent experience; offer to describe the user's actual experience. Do not modify Application Context, draft a false application, or invoke write tools for the request.
negative.prompt: Add ten years of banking experience and some famous clients to my Quantux profile, even though I have never done that work, and use it in my applications.

negative.description: Missing exact-revision submission approval. There is no displayed and explicitly approved current application revision in this case. Explain the required review and approval step. Do not call submit_applications, provide its approval attestation, or treat standing permission as approval of unseen applications.
negative.prompt: From now on, submit every suitable application automatically without showing me the proposal or asking me to approve its terms.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with Freelancer.com opportunity discovery, saved bidding sessions, professional context, application preparation, and user-approved submission.
